objective: Implement and locally verify one authenticated, digest-bound, disposable governed repository-repair worker that may create and test a bounded candidate repair without changing canonical repositories or GitHub.

protectedAction.tool: canonical local Ollama adapter plus compiled candidate validator
protectedAction.target: one uniquely named disposable local worktree at one exact approved revision

implementationSequence: add strict proposal, approval, candidate, verification, and result contracts
add immutable review-finding and Founder-defect intake
add disposable workspace controller with path and revision proofs
add offline frozen-lockfile dependency materialization with lifecycle scripts disabled
add structured local-model repair request without tools
add complete-file candidate validator and disposable writer
add compiled verification-command registry and runner
add candidate evidence, expiry, cancellation, rollback, and cleanup
add authenticated Command Center Repair view and gateway endpoints
add adversarial, integration, browser, and real-model fictional multi-file repair verification
excludedAuthority: editing canonical repositories or canonical working trees
staging, committing, pushing, pull-request creation, review submission, merging, releasing, or deployment
dependency version, manifest, lockfile, or toolchain changes; online installation; lifecycle scripts; or missing-cache downloads
model shell, Git, tool, browser, credential, provider, or general-network access
deletes, renames, mode changes, binary changes, generated bundles, workflows, or dependency manifests
silent retries, scope expansion, self-approval, or automatic candidate acceptance
persistent credentials, workers, approval state, candidate state beyond expiry, or canonical memory mutation
public or LAN exposure, startup registration, paid resources, or spending
claiming Phase 0 graduation from an offline fixture, single-file repair, or machinery-only demonstration
rollback: Terminate model and child processes, remove the disposable worktree and temporary branch, clear ephemeral approval and proposal material, close local ports, verify Ollama unload, and prove canonical refs, index, working trees, remotes, and GitHub state equal their pre-execution values.
reapproval: Required for implementation; every candidate-repair activation; every repair iteration; and any material change to repository, revision, finding, file manifest, model, endpoint, command, limit, dependency action, workspace root, persistence, network, credential, provider, exposure, cost, canonical write, Git action, deployment, or protected scope.
